title: Module review
subtitle: Everything about the Rheingau
objectives: Describe the Rheingau's land and grapes
Explain the Spätlese story and VDP

steps.prompt: Match each term to its meaning.
steps.explanation: The Rheingau's history is monastic and noble.

steps.prompt: Why do Rheingau vineyards get so much sun?
options: They face south across the Rhine
steps.explanation: The Rhine turns west, giving south-facing slopes.

steps.prompt: Riesling covers about 78% of the Rheingau.
steps.explanation: Yes, the highest share in Germany.

steps.prompt: Order the VDP levels from broadest to most precise.
Spätlese was born at Schloss Johannisberg in ____.
steps.explanation: When the harvest messenger arrived late.

steps.title: What you learned
points: The Rheingau faces south where the Rhine turns west
Riesling dominates, with Spätburgunder in Assmannshausen
Spätlese was born at Schloss Johannisberg in 1775
The VDP classifies sites; GG means dry top wine
